blocks.text: Ketones are made by oxidising secondary alcohols: CH3CH(OH)CH3 + [O] -> CH3COCH3 + H2O (K2Cr2O7 + H2SO4, heat), propan-2-ol giving propanone. The same procedure is used as for aldehydes, but because ketones are not oxidised further to carboxylic acids under these conditions, the ketone does not have to be distilled off immediately.

blocks.prompt: Which alcohol would you oxidise to make butanone, CH3COCH2CH3?

items: Secondary alcohol + [O] -> ketone; ketones are not oxidised further.
